_source: Minimal constants from the owner's tools/sghd_evidence.py report on the English Steam STEINS;GATE install (Thread 05, 2026-10-08). The private report itself is not committed. Only facts the sghd profile depends on are recorded here. Thread 06 added constants from the owner's second-round tools/sghd_census.py report (also private, not committed).

archives._note: USRDIR/<name>, all MPK v2.0, uncompressed entries (compression 0). Entry counts identify the build.

script_mpk._note: Startup script and system scripts (ids and names).

system_mpk._note: Complete system.mpk table of contents (id -> entry name).

audio._note: Codec of every entry by header (census): all Ogg Vorbis, uncompressed.

movies._note: Loose files, not in an archive. Every file starts with 4b 42 32 6a ('KB2j', Bink 2), which FFmpeg/impacto cannot decode.

sprite_sheets._note: profiles/sghd/sprites.lua sheet -> system.mpk entry, chosen by name. Sheet sizes are verified (system_images); sprite rectangles are PS3 x1.5 and NOT verified. null = no Steam counterpart in system.mpk; the sheet is ScriptHandled.
sprite_sheets.Title: TITLE_CHIP.DDS

system_images._note: system.mpk image sizes [width, height, format] (census). Every DDS is DXT5 with no mip count.

design_resolution._note: Full-screen masks BLOGMASK.DDS and TIPSMASK.DDS are 1920x1080 and LAY vertices are 1080p pixels, so the profile uses a 1920x1080 design (script coordinates are scaled from 720p by impacto).

font._note: FONT.PNG and FONT2.PNG: same grid; FONT2 differs only in rows 2-3 (full-width Latin centred instead of left-aligned proportional). Ink per cell measured at alpha > 0x20. 15 inked cells in row 45 match the 2895-glyph sc3tools charset (45*64 + 15).

lay._note: chara.mpk LAY (first three files): little-endian header (big-endian reading gives absurd state counts); texture coordinates are pixels (max x 2017 in a 2048-wide texture); file size = 8 + 12*states + 16*vertices + vertices, i.e. one trailing byte per vertex that impacto ignores.

census_layouts._note: Layouts the first census proved or added (docs/sghd-decode-integrity.md).

10 3A.evidence: label entry 10 3A 2D 0A A0 3F 14 00: one complete expression (TV[63]); the sgps3 handler read a type byte and desynced

10 0D.evidence: 18 labels of 13 bytes each start 10 0D 01 2D 0A A0 3F 14 = CHAmove type 1, expression, label, Return

phone_subtypes._note: 10 37 / 10 38 sub-type use counts across all 190 scripts (census).

variable_refs._note: Hundreds-buckets of ScrWork / FlagWork indices named by immediates in the scripts (census); used to judge save ranges.

voice_table._note: system.mpk id 31 WAVTABLE.DAT (lip-sync table loaded by 00 31) starts b0 38 00 00: as little-endian u16 that is 14512, the voice.mpk entry count; read big-endian (impacto's console default) it is 45112 and overruns the file.
